title: Reference Dataset & Free Open-Source Architecture Research
summary: Research on structuring the hackathon's five-scheme reference dataset and selecting free, open-source LLM, TTS, and ASR tooling across three prototype milestones.
notes: Type and precedence taken from manifest (authoritative). Content is explanatory research: dataset analysis, an illustrative JSON schema example, and free-tool recommendations per milestone. No ADR status/decision-record structure and no user stories or acceptance criteria, so it yields context only; the schema shown is illustrative rather than a binding contract.
